chunks: (Remember) when Moses said to his family: "I see a fire. I shall bring you news from it, or bring an ember that you may warm yourselves."
ai.seo_question: What did Moses tell his family when he saw the fire?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Naml, this verse marks the pivotal moment before Prophet Moses (AS) receives divine revelation, highlighting his dual role as both a messenger and a provider for his family. Shia exegetes often interpret the 'news' (khabar) as the initial divine call or the Torah, while the 'spark' (shihab) symbolizes the light of guidance or the warmth of faith he would bring back. This incident underscores the transition from the wilderness of preparation to the mission of prophethood.
